items.title: How to use AI to augment learning without losing critical thinking skills?
items.raw_excerpt: Lately I have been using AI more in my day to day learning. I typically use it to generate boilerplate code, ask it to explain some concept I’m having trouble grasping in an easier way and fact checking what it says while asking for deeper clarification (why is something done this way, what are others ways it can be done, comparing and contrasting etc. I basically use it as a tutor. I don’t use it to really “do” anything for me. I program most everything by hand and anything that has to do with problem solving I do myself. But I won’t lie and say I’m not scared of becoming reliant on AI. I think the way I’m using it is pretty good. Improve learning while continue to apply knowledge myself. But I’d like to know where I can improve my AI usage and how you guys are using AI in your workflow.

items.title: 从「工具」到「搭档」，AI4S 走过深水区 | 2025年终回顾
items.raw_excerpt: 在这一轮波澜壮阔的人工智能浪潮中，我们常被算力、模型规模和颠覆式叙事所簇拥。然而，真正值得记录的变化，往往发生在那些远离喧嚣的实验室里、发生在一行行代码与科学假设的碰撞中：AI 是如何从一种“使能技术”，演变为改变人类推进科研的基本范式的？ 2025年，AI4Science（AI4S）不再仅仅是论文中的愿景。它正以一种极其务实且具体的姿态，嵌入到每一位科学家的日常。 在这一年里，我们看到 AI4S 呈现出多维度的进化： 它是高效的“科研加速器”： 从润色论文到整理会议纪要，从自动化数据处理到启发科学假设，正如吴琦教授与许东教授所言，AI 正在将科学家从低效的试错中解放，让他们重新聚焦于“创造性思维”本身。 它是认知的“破局者”： 无论是 AlphaFold 3 的持续震撼，还是 Noetik 的虚拟细胞模型，AI 开始突破传统学科的藩篱。樊隽轩教授与张清鹏教授都观察到，当数据被转化为 AI 可理解的要素，两个独立领域被真正贯通，认知的“红利”正加速转化为科研的“生产力”。 它是未来的“自主探索者”： 尽管如张晓峰教授所指，AI Scientist 尚处初级阶段，但“自动化发现”（Automation）已成为杜沅岂等年轻学者眼中的确定未来。 正如李国杰院士在寄语中所指出：AI4S 正在让思维本身成为可工程化的对象。如果说 2024 年是 AI 获得科学界最高荣誉诺贝尔奖的加冕礼，那么 2025 年则是 AI 深入科研的“现场记录”。 步入 2026 年，我们不仅关注模型能力的突破，更期待“AI 专家”与“学科专家”的深度共融，期待鄂维南院士所构想的“超级实验室”与开源共享生态的落地。 为此，雷峰网邀请了来自顶级高校及一线科研机构的多位AI 专家与学科专家，通过他们的亲历与洞察，还原一个真实、诚恳且充满可能性的 AI4S 2025。这不仅是一次年度总结，更是一份通往“

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 12, the eighth GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference officially commenced in Shenzhen. The two-day event was jointly organized by the GAIR Institute and Leiphone, with Academician Gao Wen serving as the chair of the steering committee, and Academician Yang Qiang and Professor Zhu Xiaorui as conference chairs. The conference featured three thematic forums focusing on topics such as large models, embodied intelligence, computing power transformation, reinforcement learning, and world models, showcasing the forefront of AI exploration and reflecting the intelligent future jointly built by academia and industry. As a benchmark event in the AI industry-academia-research-investment community, GAIR has adhered to the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016, serving as a platform for intellectual exchange in AI academia and a spiritual home for China's 40-year AI development. Over the past four years, large models have driven accelerated transformation in the AI industry. As the year draws to a close, GAIR returns as scheduled, fostering high-quality idea exchanges to present cutting-edge insights into the AI era for the industry and the public. On December 13, at the "World Models" session, Xiu Yuliang, assistant professor at Westlake University and head of the Yuanxi Laboratory, delivered a speech titled "Out of the Wax Museum, Into a New Interactive World: Exploring New Frontiers in 3D Digital Human Research," sharing three latest advancements in high-precision digital human reconstruction. Xiu Yuliang introduced the laboratory's three recent projects: UP2You, ETCH, and Human3R. Due to the combined challenges of varying camera poses and human movements, reconstructing high-precision digital humans from unrestricted daily images remains a complex task.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Skyris was originally inspired by a guinea pig named Tuntun. It was the most homebound pet Zhang Yunuo ever had, spending its days lying among a group of young entrepreneurs, rarely moving, quietly accepting praise and petting. At the time, Zhang Yunuo was working on delivery drones in the United States when a friend suddenly asked him, why can’t guinea pigs fly? Tuntun never took flight, but the combination of flight and pets perfectly aligned the two pieces of Skyris. Or perhaps Zhang Yunuo had always wanted to focus on pets—the voice box is as "homebound" as a guinea pig, and flight merely gives them the ability to actively provide companionship, much like what Zhang Yunuo felt from his other pets.

Zhang Yunuo has kept many pets: five dogs, three cats, a snake, a guinea pig, and soon, a parrot. The story began when he was five years old, when a Tibetan Mastiff almost as tall as himself became his companion. At the time, Zhang Yunuo was still afraid of dogs. He ran, and it chased, until his legs could no longer move, and "being eaten" seemed like an option. Zhang Yunuo lay on the ground, giving up. But the Tibetan Mastiff just trotted over with its large head, looked at him, and then lowered its head to lick his face.

"From then on, I was never afraid of dogs again. I knew it wouldn’t hurt me." Zhang Yunuo decided to name it Jinjin.

Zhang Yunuo has always felt that the true companionship he experienced came from these pets. Sometimes, self-expression leads to loneliness, and in those moments of being misunderstood, anyone can become an "outsider" in a crowd. Studying, starting a business... Zhang Yunuo repeatedly experienced these moments at different stages of his life.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según Skyris, la inspiración inicial provino del conejillo de indias holandés Tuntun. Era la mascota más hogareña que Zhang Yunuo había tenido, acostada diariamente entre un grupo de jóvenes emprendedores, rara vez se movía, aceptando silenciosamente elogios y caricias. En ese momento, Zhang Yunuo trabajaba en drones de entrega en Estados Unidos, y un día un amigo le preguntó de repente: ¿por qué los conejillos de indias holandeses no pueden volar? Tuntun finalmente no despegó, pero la combinación de vuelo y mascotas encajó perfectamente en las dos piezas del rompecabezas de Skyris. O tal vez, lo que Zhang Yunuo siempre quiso hacer fueron solo mascotas; la caja de voz es tan hogareña como un conejillo de indias holandés, y el vuelo simplemente les otorga la capacidad de acompañar activamente, tal como Zhang Yunuo había sentido con otras mascotas. Zhang Yunuo ha tenido muchas mascotas: cinco.

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 12, the eighth GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced in Shenzhen. The two-day event was jointly organized by the GAIR Institute and Leiphone, with Academician Gao Wen serving as the chair of the steering committee, and Academician Yang Qiang and Professor Zhu Xiaorui as the conference chairs. As a key window for observing the evolution of AI technology and ecosystem changes, the GAIR Summit has resonated with the pulse of global AI development since its inception in 2016, witnessing technological waves surge from laboratories into the depths of industry. In 2025, a critical juncture where large models transition from "technological breakthroughs" to "value deepening," GAIR arrived as scheduled, collaborating with experts to explore the forefront of AI and gain insights into the underlying logic of the industry. At the summit, Dr. Xue Guirong, Chief Technology Officer of the Scientific Model Group at the Zhejiang Laboratory and CEO of Tianrang Intelligence, delivered an engaging presentation. Dr. Xue pointed out that while AI technologies, represented by large language models, have shown potential in multiple disciplines, they remain fundamentally constrained by the "boundaries of language," struggling to truly understand high-dimensional, diverse scientific data and independently achieve verifiable scientific discoveries. Based on this, Dr. Xue systematically analyzed the essential differences between large language models and scientific foundation models, detailing the key advantages of the 021 scientific foundation model developed by the Zhejiang Laboratory in transcending language dimensions, unifying scientific data, enabling scientific reasoning and discovery, and integrating interdisciplinary knowledge. He also raised considerations regarding "AI + Science"

Como una ventana crucial para observar la evolución tecnológica y los cambios en el ecosistema de la IA, la conferencia GAIR ha estado en sintonía con el pulso del desarrollo global de la IA desde su fundación en 2016, presenciando cómo las olas tecnológicas pasan del laboratorio a las profundidades industriales. En 2025, un año clave en el que los grandes modelos pasan de "romper barreras técnicas" a "profundizar en el valor", GAIR llega puntualmente, uniendo a expertos para explorar las fronteras más avanzadas de la IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng.com exclusively learned that AI coding startup AIGCode recently completed consecutive rounds of financing led by Bohua Capital and Lihe Capital respectively, with Lihe Financial and multiple industrial capital investors participating. Founded in January 2024, the company did not follow the trend of Copilot-like products but decided from Day 1 to focus on developing end-to-end Autopilot products.
